qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When the siren sounds, passengers will please make their way to the assembly point without delay. [G = Come quickly.]
1. Would staff please remain at their desks today until midday while preparations for the IT system intensive monitoring check are being made.
2. Please give all of the material a very intensive examination: if we make a mistake at this point, this is what people will remember us for until the end of time.
3. In appearance, these two spiders are remarkably similar; caution is required, as a mistake in handling could prove to be a memorable experience.
4. You must keep in mind that someone has to look after grandma this weekend. Her care schedule is not difficult, and she mustn't leave the house!
5. This examination is very important and the outcome is going to remain with you for the rest of your life so make sure your preparation is thorough.
items: 1 — Staff please remain at desks until midday during the IT monitoring check.
2 — Give all material a very intensive examination — a mistake now will define us.
3 — These two spiders are similar; caution is required in handling them.
4 — Someone has to look after grandma this weekend. She mustn't leave the house!
5 — This examination is very important. Make sure your preparation is thorough.

qs.q:
Where is Tara going to spend her weekend?

"Despite my original plan to stay with you this weekend, I'll be away, writing that essay on my own. Mum and I have two days to clean grandma's beach house, which is a bore, but the fresh air will surely do me good."

A At home.
B At the seaside.
C At Jemma's house.

How does Jim feel about the video game?

"I spent the entire evening yesterday checking out that game you recommended. I can't understand how anyone could say it isn't fun. It might not be easy for inexperienced players to master since it's quite complex, but I just had a blast. Thanks!"

A It's entertaining.
B It's difficult.
C It's boring.

How is Manny going to travel to work tomorrow?

"Thanks for offering to give me a lift tomorrow, but it turns out my boss wants me to get to work an hour earlier. The bus would be the most comfortable option for me since I don't like being underground, but the tube station is the closest to my house, so I'll go for that."

A By car.
B By bus.
C By train.

Why isn't Donna going to the party?

"Now that I've finally convinced my mother to let me go to that party by promising to improve my grades, my temperature has shot up! Can you believe it? There's no way it'll go away by tomorrow night, so you'll have to go without me."

A She isn't allowed to.
B She isn't feeling well.
C She has to do her homework.
opts: She has to do her homework.

qs.q:
What is Susanna getting for her birthday?

"We've been browsing an online jewellery shop to find a gift for Susanna's birthday and they have both necklaces and bracelets that match the earrings she received from her boyfriend. The necklace is a bit more expensive, but we remembered how she once mentioned that she didn't like wearing anything around her wrists, which made our decision easier."

A A necklace.
B A bracelet.
C Earrings.

The Silent Hero

"Best known for his iconic stage persona 'Bip the Clown', whose name is based on Pip, a character from Dickens' novel 'Great Expectations'."

Who was 'Bip the Clown'?
A A character from a novel.
B A cartoon character.
C A mime character.

The Silent Hero

"Marceau was recruited by his cousin, Georges Loinger, the commander of a secret Jewish relief group that smuggled Jewish children from occupied France to neutral countries."

What did Marcel do thanks to his cousin?
A He changed his name.
B He joined the French Resistance.
C He became the leader of the Resistance.
opts: He became the leader of the Resistance.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"The group's mission was to evacuate Jewish children hidden in a French orphanage and get them to the Swiss border, where they would find safety."

What was the purpose of the Jewish relief group?
A To transport children to a safe place.
B To take a group of children on holiday.
C To hide children in a French orphanage.
opts: To transport children to a safe place.
To take a group of children on holiday.
To hide children in a French orphanage.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"Once he disguised himself as a boy scout leader and took 24 Jewish kids in scout uniforms through the forests to the border. When he unexpectedly ran into a group of German soldiers, he pretended that he was a member of the French Army and convinced all 30 of them to surrender."

How did Marcel avoid being killed by a group of German soldiers?
A By pretending to be a French soldier.
B By wearing a boy scout uniform.
C By surrendering to them.
opts: By pretending to be a French soldier.
By wearing a boy scout uniform.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"The silent hero soon skyrocketed to worldwide fame, thanks to the universality of his expression. As he said – mime, like music, knows neither borders nor nationalities."

Why did audiences across the world love Marcel's performances?
A Because of the music he played.
B Because everyone would do them.
C Because everyone could understand them.
opts: Because of the music he played.

Read the message from Ella:

"Hi!
I'm going to take the Spanish course in September, and I'm wondering how you're getting on with your language course.
What are your impressions after your first semester?
What aspects of the course did you like best and why?
What methods of learning would you advise and why?
Ella"

Write Ella a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 80–100 words.

You will hear five voice messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — I'll make it.
B — Try again.
C — Pick me up.
D — Come over.
E — Hurry up.
F — It's not allowed.

You hear a patient making an appointment at the doctor's office.
What is the patient's surname?

You hear a boy talking about his upcoming maths exam.
How does he feel about it?

You hear a student talking about going to the seaside.
What is her main reason for going there?

You hear a man discussing the finding of a survey.
What proportion of the people surveyed would buy the organic selection again?

You hear a woman talking about her garden.
What is her favourite flower?

You hear a radio interview with Janine Sutton about her floating restaurant.

Why did Janine start the floating restaurant?
opts: She was bored of working in a bank.

qs.q: Who are Janine's customers, for the most part?
opts: People who want a new experience.

qs.q: What is the most difficult part of Janine's job?
opts: Making sure the menu has variety.

qs.q: What is the hardest part of daily management?
What are Janine's plans for the future?
opts: To keep things as they are.
